svg.title: AI Video Interviewer
svg.desc: AI Video Interviewer — hackathon · in progress. Joins a live video call and interviews a candidate with questions grounded in their resume, the job description and their actual GitHub code. Pipeline: JD + resume → GitHub evidence → gap analysis → question plan → recruiter gate → live call. Built with Python, LangGraph, LiveKit, Gemini Realtime, FastAPI, SQLite.
svg.text: Joins a live video call and interviews a candidate with
questions grounded in their resume, the job description
